title: StateRecord
description: A durable or semi-durable memory/state record in BrainCaseDB. StateRecords are internal until explicitly rendered. memory_domain is the configured isolation value recorded at write time — the schema does not define, grant, or authorize memory_domain values. Records are written only through explicit memory tool actions, never automatically ingested.

memory_domain.description: Configured isolation boundary for this record. This is the value configured by the operator/user — the schema does not define, grant, infer, or authorize domain values. Missing memory_domain at write time should resolve to 'isolated'.

tier.description: Memory tier classifying purpose, retention, and default visibility within the memory_domain.

record_type.description: Semantic classification of the record's content.

claim.description: The durable claim, fact, or assertion this record stores. Should be a complete sentence. Must not include raw prompts or raw request body content.

summary.description: Brief human-readable summary for recall/render. Must not include raw prompts or raw request body content.

visibility.description: Controls whether this record can ever become model-visible. 'internal' means never surfaced to the model directly. 'renderable' means eligible for inclusion in a RenderPacket when explicitly requested. 'never_model_visible' means permanently excluded from any render path.

confidence.description: Confidence in the claim, from 0.0 (uncertain) to 1.0 (certain).

importance.description: Relative importance for ranking during recall and render, from 0.0 to 1.0.

created_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this record was first written.

updated_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this record was last updated.

source_refs.description: List of source_ref_id values providing provenance for this record. Sessions/turns/requests may appear here only as bounded provenance references, not as automatic logs.

supersedes.description: record_id of the record this supersedes. Null if this is an original record.

superseded_by.description: record_id of the record that supersedes this one. Null if still active.

metadata.description: Optional bounded key-value metadata. Must not store raw prompts, raw request bodies, or content that would constitute automatic ingestion.
